content:
monica: Heads up — onboarding sampleapp CI failed during a typegen regen step; auth/retry tests are flapping. CI link: https://ci.redwood.internal/2147
build-bot: [job failed] typegen-regenerate • see logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/2147/logs
monica: repro steps I ran locally: `git checkout feature/onboard && pnpm install && pnpm run regen`
monica: short log/snippet from the failure:
```
Error: snapshot mismatch in sampleapp/auth.test.ts
- expect(retryAttempts).toEqual(3)
+ expect(retryAttempts).toEqual(2)
```
alex: ugh. sounds like a typegen output ordering or default value drift. did the OpenAPI reorder props?
devex_bryan: we saw nondet property ordering earlier. we added a `--stable-sort` flag to typegen but it never got wired into the CI workflow. try `yarn typegen --stable-sort` locally and regen to confirm.
sara: also noticed another failure in the publish gating: package.json is bumped to 1.4.0 but CHANGELOG only has 1.3.1 entry. semver/changelog-check step failed on the branch.
alex: ok, two parts — (1) flaky typegen output ordering, (2) semver/changelog gating. will handle temp fixes.
monica: for (1) i ran `yarn typegen --stable-sort && pnpm run regen` and locally tests passed. diff looked like small reorderings.
monica: example diff fragment: 
```
-  optional: false
+  optional: true
```
alex: good catch. (2) for the gating i can add a quick workflow change to pin typegen CLI to 0.32.1 in the `regen` job and add a `pnpm run regen` sanity step before semver-check. that should stop the nondet at CI while we push proper fix.
devex_bryan: for longer-term we should make typegen stable-by-default and add a test that runs `yarn typegen --check-stable` in CI to detect ordering drift. file an RFC?
sara: filing a short ticket for changelog/semver mismatch too — we've seen this bite new-hires during onboarding. link PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/582
alex: created quickfix PR to pin CLI & run regen in workflow: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/583 — includes commit `ci: pin typegen cli & regen before semver-check`
ci-bot: Re-run triggered for build #2147 by alex.
build-bot: build #2147 rerun started • workflows: regen -> tests -> semver-check
monica: rerun looks green so far on my branch. tests: 128 passed, 2 skipped.
monica: merged the quickfix PR to the branch. CI on main looks green after the rerun. :thumbsup:
alex: follow-ups: (a) typegen default to stable-sort, (b) add regen check in prepublish workflow, (c) add unit that asserts auth retry default hasn't changed. I'll open issues.
devex_bryan: i'll take (a) and coordinate with eng-runtime if kernel selection/compilation changes affect generator shapes.
sara: I'll add a tiny onboarding note about regen + semver checks in the quickstart doc so new devs don't hit this.
monica: thanks all — moving this thread to Done for now but leaving the tickets open for the followups.
